purpose: Define the exact boundary where resolved IAM identity and current assurance context are supplied to AccessCore as authorization inputs without allowing IAM to decide governed rights.

owns: IAM Assurance to AccessCore Binding semantics

topics.name: IAM Assurance to AccessCore Binding
topics.purpose: Define the exact boundary where resolved IAM identity and current assurance context are supplied to AccessCore as authorization inputs without allowing IAM to decide governed rights.

semantics.assurance_rule: IAM supplies current assurance state and applicable reauthentication evidence.
semantics.authorization_rule: AccessCore alone evaluates governed allow/deny/reauth-required policy.
semantics.nonexpansion_rule: High assurance cannot expand rights absent AccessCore permission.
semantics.group_rule: IAM/IdentityCore organization relations do not automatically become AccessCore groups.
semantics.remote_rule: Origin IAM identity/assurance context may propagate to remote target, which evaluates its own AccessCore policy.
semantics.trace_rule: Authorization decision can trace which IAM identity/assurance context was evaluated.

invariants.rule: IAM composes identity, authentication/assurance, PortfolioCore and MeritCore references while preserving each component's ownership; AccessCore authorization remains orthogonal.

hard_gates.condition: organization membership silently becomes AccessCore group
remote origin rights copied as remote rights
authorization decision cannot trace IAM context

prose.summary: Define the exact boundary where resolved IAM identity and current assurance context are supplied to AccessCore as authorization inputs without allowing IAM to decide governed rights.
